title: October 19 · 50-site review queue
focusNote: Hinds 110 remains the founder-priority lead. This run does not change founder focus.
buyerHypothesis: 20–30 MW initial facility load (25 MW working screen), 50 MW expansion, low-water profile, two physically diverse carrier paths and raw-land economics preferably below $1 million.
conclusion: Follow-up screening added Rooks Road at equal founder-requested research priority. New Castle needs tract and utility-boundary documents; Williston’s eastern 76-acre parcel has an adverse county denial history. Dillon continues; Adairsville screening is stopped. No site is cleared for paid control.
capitalDecision: $0 new spend. No outreach, option, application or paid diligence authorized.
methodology: Exactly 50 unique listing URLs checked against the existing Deal Desk.
Research class orders documentary follow-up only; it is not the formal PRIORITY tier.
Transmission, substation and voltage references are proximity signals—not available MW.
Unknown price, APN, fiber, capacity and entitlement fields remain explicit unknowns.

candidates.name: New Castle State Road 3 & Riley Road
candidates.signal: Most mapped soils are well drained, but offered acreage and the load service point are unresolved. Public utility polygons split the matched tax geometry between Henry County REMC and Duke Energy.
candidates.risk: 44.35-acre offering / old 49.634-acre legal / 43.55 GIS acres disagree; two utility polygons intersect.
candidates.nextTest: Get the post-split survey and legal description, then ask both utilities for a coordinated exact-premises/service-point determination and the applicable load-study process.
candidates.evidenceLevel: Targeted desktop screen · public records plus marketing; no verified available MW
candidates.novelty: New to this Deal Desk batch; listing age may predate the run

candidates.name: Williston Highway 1804 / 48th Street NW
candidates.signal: The advertised group spans different tax owners. County records tie the eastern 76-acre parcel to a 2024 data-center setback denial; no current lawful cure or subject MW allocation was found.
candidates.risk: Historic exact-parcel setback failure, no written cure, no power commitment, possible sponsor-scale study costs.
candidates.nextTest: Ask the broker for the exact current lot/APN schedule and the county for any written decision curing the February 2024 denial on 35-035. Hold paid pursuit absent that evidence.
candidates.evidenceLevel: Targeted desktop screen · public records plus marketing; no verified available MW
candidates.novelty: New to this Deal Desk batch; listing age may predate the run
